newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ericsson's Ramqvist sees no major buys.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson's Ramqvist sees no major buys.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Thursday it was not currently planning to make any major acquisitions, one reason being the burden of research and development is causing on the company's cash flow.

"Organic growth is the way we will follow now. Research and development demand a lot of money. We would of course be able to buy a big company if we stopped completely with research and development but there are no such plans," CEO Lars Ramqvist said at a news conference during the Cebit technology fair.
Ramqvist also spoke of the importance of cooperation.
"We need our partners, we can't develop everything alone" he said.
